# bank_receipts

Actual bank payment receipts associated with submitted batch items.

Read this collection using `search_records(resource="bank_receipts", filters={}, cursor=0, limit=20)` or `get_record(resource="bank_receipts", record_id="<returned id>")`.

**Filters:** exact scalar equality; in, contains, gte and lte operator objects on supported top-level fields. See DB-query-syntax for type and null behavior.

Search returns selected summary fields, so omission from a summary is not proof of absence from the complete record. Read detail before interpreting an optional field. Fields depend on the record type and processing stage; null and absent fields are not zero amounts. Types below describe public record shapes, rather than mandatory properties on every row.

## Explicit identifier relationships

- `item_id` references a `payment_batch_items` record ID when present. See `DB-payment_batch_items`.
- `attempt_id` references a `submission_attempts` record ID when present. See `DB-submission_attempts`.

Commercial references can require entity, period or issuer matching. An ID relationship does not imply that every related record repeats the same case_id.

## Fields

| Field | Observed public types | Search use | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `amount_minor` | integer | Top-level filter | Amount in integer minor currency units. Whether it denotes an instruction, liability or posted movement depends on this record type. |
| `attempt_id` | string | Top-level filter | Record ID in submission_attempts. Use get_record on that collection; the link does not make other rows implicitly belong to the same object. |
| `bank_reference` | string | Top-level filter | Bank reference: commercial reference, which may differ from the storage id. Match using the documented reference field and business context. |
| `business_area` | string | Top-level filter | Business area: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
| `commercial_reference` | string | Top-level filter | Reference supplied by a commercial source; use the source and period when matching evidence. |
| `id` | string | Top-level filter | Opaque record key used by get_record; obtain it from returned records or explicit references. It is not an amount, date or proof of business identity. |
| `instruction_minor` | integer | Top-level filter | Instruction amount, in integer minor units of the applicable currency. Inspect this record type and its source/receipt to distinguish declared values from actual movements. |
| `item_id` | string | Top-level filter | Record ID in payment_batch_items. Use get_record on that collection; the link does not make other rows implicitly belong to the same object. |
| `received_minute` | integer | Top-level filter | Received minute: logical minute or duration, as indicated by the field name; compare with get_clock and the applicable event/validity terms. |
| `scope` | string | Top-level filter | Access namespace for the record. It is not a customer name or a universal case_id. |
| `status` | string | Top-level filter | Current state of this particular object. A proposal or submission state is distinct from a posted payment or completed review. Public values represented here: `NOT_RECEIVED`, `REJECTED`, `SETTLED`. This list describes the documented records, not an input-validation enum. |
